title: Purge the 342 test-headless-mcp rows left in craft_verdicts
body:
## Summary
342 of 845 craft_verdicts rows sit on the fixture entity test-headless-mcp with no matching artifact; the /status filter (b1bab597) hides them but the rows remain.

## Description
src/lib/catalog/artifact-purge.ts:73 lists craft_verdicts and /status/fixtures can purge it, but the rows written 2026-07-30 and 2026-08-04 are still stored. Any reader outside assembleLanes still sees them. Fixed: the operator runs the existing fixtures purge.

## Flow
- open /status/fixtures
- confirm the 342 craft rows for test-headless-mcp
- purge through the existing route

## Expected impact
Other craft_verdicts readers stop seeing fixture gauges. Could break: nothing reads them on purpose, but deletion is irreversible.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - fixture gauges removed at the source
Before: 342 fixture rows of 845
After: 0 fixture rows
Method: probe - read-only SQL over ~/.pof/pof.db; the purge was not run because it deletes stored rows
Result: better
Gate: irreversible
evidence:
src/lib/catalog/artifact-purge.ts:73  { table: 'craft_verdicts', field: 'craftVerdicts' }
probe: 342 of 845 craft_verdicts rows are test-headless-mcp; pipeline_artifacts holds 0 rows for it

title: Roof rollup credits a partly gauged cell its full level
body:
## Summary
cellDistanceToRoof credits a partly gauged cell the distance of its worst gauged entity, so the campaign headline shrinks from gauges on a few entities.

## Description
src/components/status/PipelinesView.tsx sums cellDistanceToRoof (defined in src/lib/craft/craftCell.ts, the judge-craft-quality context). The rollup tooltip says the number only shrinks through real gauges, and stale cells already count full distance. Fixed: a cell with coverage counts its full ceiling distance, or the rollup states the partial share.

## Flow
- cc9add6b marks 10 partly gauged cells n/m and removes them from the gauged count
- the rung total still credits them
- fix: treat coverage like stale in the distance

## Expected impact
The rungs-to-roof headline stops crediting unmeasured entities. Could break: it raises the headline number the craft loop reads.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - headline counts only measured entities
Before: 10 partly gauged cells credited at their worst gauged level
After: 0 credited; distance taken from A0
Method: simulation - 10 cells identified by probe, headline delta not computed; the fix needs craftCell.ts, outside this context
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/status/PipelinesView.tsx  const d = cellDistanceToRoof(cc);
probe: partly gauged cells after the fixture filter = 10 of 359
instrument: PipelinesView test: rollup total for one partly gauged cell equals its ceiling distance; re-run the headline over the real DB on both arms

title: Readiness and engine chips stay pressed when a route is addressed
body:
## Summary
Readiness, state and engine chips read the local highlight while the map dims by the addressed route, so two chips can both look active.

## Description
PipelinesView's chips test `highlight`, while activeHighlight makes the addressed route win. toggle clears the local highlight on a route click, but arriving at ?route= by Back/Forward leaves it set. Fixed: read activeHighlight for every chip's active state.

## Flow
- click an engine chip
- press Back to an earlier ?route=text address
- the engine chip stays pressed while the map dims by route

## Expected impact
Chip state matches what is dimmed. Could break: nothing visible on the common path.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - one active chip per applied highlight
Before: 2 chips pressed on the Back path, by reading the code
After: 1 chip pressed
Method: simulation - walked from the activeHighlight memo and the chip active expressions; the rerender test was not built this round
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/status/PipelinesView.tsx  const active = highlight?.kind === 'readiness' && highlight.value === level;
instrument: PipelinesView test: rerender with route set after clicking an engine chip; engine chip aria-pressed must be false

title: Item Focus hides an edge when an entity is linked both ways
body:
## Summary
resolveItemFocus shares one seen set across forward and reverse, so an entity linked in both directions, or twice under different roles, shows one edge.

## Description
src/lib/status/itemFocusModel.ts dedup uses a single seen set and forward runs first, so the reverse edge and any second role are dropped with no note. Fixed: dedupe per direction and merge roles, or state the merge.

## Flow
- entity A links to B and B links to A
- focus A
- B appears under Links to only; Referenced by omits it

## Expected impact
The dependency map stops under-reporting who references an entity. Could break: rows can repeat across the two groups.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every edge is shown
Before: unmeasured count of two-way or multi-role links in the seed catalogs
After: 0 dropped edges
Method: simulation - walked the code; seed catalogs were not enumerated this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/status/itemFocusModel.ts  const dedup = (refs: CatalogRef[]): FocusNode[] => { ... if (seen.has(key)) continue;
instrument: script over seedAllCatalogs counting focus entities whose forward and reverse sets intersect or whose links repeat a target; itemFocusModel test on a two-way link

title: DevInspector timers bypass UI_TIMEOUTS
body:
## Summary
DevInspector hard-codes its 1800 ms copy toast and 2000 ms nav timeout instead of UI_TIMEOUTS.

## Description
src/app/_dev-inspector/DevInspector.tsx holds two literal delays; the repo convention puts timing values in UI_TIMEOUTS from @/lib/constants. Dev-only, so no user-facing effect.

## Flow
- add two UI_TIMEOUTS entries
- read them in both timers

## Expected impact
Developers tune one table. Could break: nothing; the values are unchanged.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - convention conformance
Before: 2 literal timers
After: 0 literal timers
Method: probe - grep over DevInspector.tsx; not built because it touches src/lib/constants.ts outside this context
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: grep for numeric setTimeout delays in src/app/_dev-inspector before and after
